gaps_disclosed: The first tool attempted a background sampler before reads, but the pre-existing worker tmpdir marker was a regular file and that process did not persist after its shell; this startup gap is retained in disk-trace.txt.
The inherited baseline trace was already present and was not treated as this worker's pre-read continuous trace.
An earlier PTY sampler was interrupted by Ctrl-C before the explicit TERM/ wait/reap sampler; its samples remain labeled in disk-trace.txt.
